column1: # Labels for sources/measure-lookups.mjs --labels: first results that are one of several lemmas the word's own wty-ka-en rows name.
# word<TAB>first result<TAB>label (W: wrong in the usual reading; A: ambiguous, context decides; R: right)<TAB>note

# (reports/audit-hachi-lang-ka-evidence/inputs/tie-labels.tsv) as the base. The other R labels were made by a rule and spot-checked:

# The file covers every such pair in the books, Tatoeba, the 10,000 most frequent words and audit-hachi-lang-ka's two texts for the pack as committed.
